name: Knowledge eval v1
description: Runs all 130 items of eval-knowledge-v1 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.
notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
